mapper.select: SELECT initiated_at,direction,automatic,COUNT(*) AS total,SUM(answered) AS connected, COALESCE(SUM(talk_duration_ms),0) AS talk_duration_ms FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(c.started_at,INTERVAL 8 HOUR), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:00:00''%Y-%m-%dT00:00:00') AS initiated_at, c.direction, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM fcc_dial_attempt a JOIN fcc_dial_job j ON j.id=a.dial_job_id WHERE a.call_id=c.id AND j.job_type='AUTO_FLOW') AS automatic, CASE WHEN c.answered_at IS NOT NULL OR c.talk_duration_ms>0 OR c.audio_duration_sec>0 OR c.status IN ('ANSWERED','COMPLETED') OR c.result='ANSWER' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS answered, c.talk_duration_ms FROM fcc_call_session c WHERE c.started_at>=#{start} AND c.started_at<#{end} ) facts GROUP BY initiated_at,direction,automatic ORDER BY initiated_at,direction,automatic
